items.text: NVIDIA $NVDA IS PLANNING SMALL-BATCH SHIPMENTS OF A NEW AI CHIP BUILT SPECIFICALLY FOR CHINA BY THE END OF THE YEAR Several Chinese customers have already placed orders. The chip is a China-specific variant of Nvidia's LPU, a new chip that works alongside Nvidia's GPUs to speed up AI chatbot processing - The Information
